bodySql:
DECLARE
                r RECORD;
                stats RECORD;
            BEGIN
                FOR r IN
                    SELECT
                        tab.relname AS tablename,
                        psat.n_live_tup AS live_tuple_count,
                        psat.n_dead_tup AS dead_tuple_count,
                        psat.last_vacuum AS last_vacuum_on,
                        psat.last_autovacuum AS last_autovacuum_on,
                        psat.autovacuum_count AS autovacuum_count
                    FROM pg_class tab
                             INNER JOIN pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid = tab.relnamespace
                             INNER JOIN pg_stat_all_tables psat ON tab.relname = psat.relname
                    WHERE tab.relkind = 'r' AND ns.nspname = 'lisa' AND psat.schemaname = 'lisa'
                    ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(tab.oid) DESC LIMIT 10
                    LOOP
                        EXECUTE format('select * from lisa.pgstattuple(''lisa.%I'')',r.tablename) INTO stats;
                        RETURN QUERY
                            SELECT r.tablename ,
                                   pg_size_pretty(stats.table_len) AS total_table_size_with_all_pages,
                                   pg_size_pretty(stats.tuple_len) AS used_space_with_actual_data,
                                   pg_size_pretty(stats.dead_tuple_len) as dead_space,
                                   pg_size_pretty(stats.free_space) AS free_space,
                                   stats.free_percent,
                                   r.live_tuple_count,
                                   r.dead_tuple_count,
                                   r.last_vacuum_on,
                                   r.last_autovacuum_on,
                                   r.autovacuum_count;
                    END LOOP;
            END;
